notes: Held back 6 June; ordered up on 7 June for a 90-mile drive from the Chartres area, losing up to ~200 vehicles to air attack. Position is the Chartres starting area named by Wikipedia; the exact start date of movement is approximate.
Panzer Lehr remained in assembly areas near Thury-Harcourt on 8 June.

Leading elements reached Tilly-sur-Seulles during the night of 9 June; checked 7th Armoured Division 10-11 June; 12-13 June elements at Villers-Bocage; 18 June Tilly changed hands 23 times (to British 18-19 June).
